criteria.requirement: Add feedparser.records.entry_identity for actual parsed entry mappings. Prefer a nonempty native string id with reliable=True; otherwise compute deterministic SHA256 from explicit selected actual fields with configurable NFC string normalization, canonical JSON and reliable=False/source=fields metadata. Never inject an id, read compatibility alias fallbacks as real facts, strip tracking parameters or identify entries merely by similar titles. Reject missing usable data, duplicate/invalid field names, nonstring native ids and unsupported/nonfinite JSON values explicitly. Preserve inputs, distinguish equal titles with different links and document fallback collision/stability scope.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
